PreToolUse.note: A hook `allow` skips hypotaxis-level approval prompts only (COMPAT 4.4); Hermes approvals and hardline blocks still apply.

PostToolUse.note: Runs for tools that executed with status ok. Feedback is appended to the tool result.

PostToolUseFailure.note: The same Hermes hook with status other than ok.

UserPromptSubmit.note: A blocked prompt is stored by Hermes as a withheld-message placeholder and never reaches a model; Claude Code erases it.

SessionStart.note: These fire after the system prompt is built, so additionalContext is delivered through the next pre_llm_call and never the system prompt. Sources: startup, resume, clear, compact. fork does not exist on Hermes.

SessionEnd.note: Hermes does not say why a session ended, so reason is other.

Stop.note: Hermes has no turn-end hook that can continue a turn, and its pre_verify fires only after write_file or patch edits (not ship). So Stop runs at the final post_llm_call of every completed turn, and a block re-enters as a queued user message through ctx.inject_message: a new turn that starts after the answer, not a continuation inside it. Needs plugins.entries.hypotaxis.allow_gateway_injection.

SubagentStart.note: Observe only; additionalContext cannot reach the child.

SubagentStop.note: Observe only; a block cannot force the child to continue.

Notification.note: approval becomes permission_prompt, clarify becomes elicitation_dialog. idle_prompt and auth_success do not exist on Hermes.

PostCompact.note: trigger is manual for /compress and auto otherwise.

unsupported.PreCompact: Hermes has only post_compaction, so a compaction cannot be observed or blocked in advance.
unsupported.PermissionRequest: pre_approval_request is an observer on Hermes, which intentionally has no auto-allow or decision callback.
unsupported.PermissionDenied: Hermes has no permission-denied event; a block is a tool result.
unsupported.UserPromptExpansion: Hermes has no equivalent: slash-command expansion is not an event.
unsupported.StopFailure: Hermes has no event for a turn that ended in an API error that reaches plugins as a stop.
unsupported.Setup: Hermes has no init or maintenance event.
unsupported.TaskCreated: Hermes kanban hooks differ in meaning from Claude Code tasks.
unsupported.TaskCompleted: Hermes kanban hooks differ in meaning from Claude Code tasks.
unsupported.TeammateIdle: Hermes kanban hooks differ in meaning from Claude Code teammates.
unsupported.WorktreeCreate: Worktrees are owned by the hypotaxis host, not by Hermes.
unsupported.WorktreeRemove: Worktrees are owned by the hypotaxis host, not by Hermes.
unsupported.Elicitation: Hermes MCP elicitation consent is an approval, not a hookable event.
unsupported.ElicitationResult: Hermes MCP elicitation consent is an approval, not a hookable event.
unsupported.InstructionsLoaded: Synthesized by compat when it delivers memory and rules, which part 1 does not do yet.
unsupported.PreModelSwitch: Synthesized by the cascade, which is not built yet.
unsupported.PostModelSwitch: Synthesized by the cascade, which is not built yet.
